content.short: ACQR pays people to learn about Web3.
content.description: ACQR is a protocol that motivates people to explore Web3, its potential, and how they can contribute using their existing skills. It provides educational tasks across topics such as blockchain fundamentals, wallets, and decentralized apps, with rewards granted upon completion. ACQR also collaborates with Web3 protocols, from newcomers to established projects, to attract and engage more active, diverse users. By pairing learning with practical participation, it creates a bridge between education and real-world project involvement, helping learners apply skills and contribute to active Web3 initiatives.
